source_row.stem: A nurse works with a client experiencing a mental health crisis to develop a safety plan, and a family member assumes this plan is really just a short list of medication reminders. This plan typically instead includes:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Content limited mainly to medication instructions, with less focus on coping strategies, warning signs, or support contacts, similar to what the family member is currently assuming","B":"Identifying warning signs, coping strategies, support contacts, and steps to take if a crisis escalates, individualized to the client, rather than just medication reminders as the family member assumed","C":"Fairly few defined components, despite safety planning being a well-established, more comprehensive crisis intervention than the family member is currently assuming","D":"A single generic instruction applied the same way to every client, without any individualized tailoring, contrary to how this plan is actually developed for each client"}}
source_row.rationale: A crisis safety plan typically includes individualized elements such as identifying personal warning signs, coping strategies, support contacts, and specific steps to take if the crisis escalates, empowering the client with a concrete plan.
source_row.source_name: SAMHSA — Safety Planning in Crisis Intervention
source_row.source_detail: Components of an Effective Safety Plan
